parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
*   You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of **NextToken**.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   **acl**: an access control list (ACL)
*   **loadbalancer**: an Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance
*   **securitypolicy**: a security policy
*   **servergroup**: a server group

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alb list-tag-resources --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 20 --resource-type loadbalancer --resource-id alb-gws76zi000000 --tag Value=product Key=env --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alb ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'alb-gws76zi000000' --Tag.1.Key env --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --MaxResults 20 --Tag.1.Value product --ResourceType loadbalancer --method POST --force
